name: Shanghai International Circuit
summary: A track shaped like the Chinese character 'shang', with a first corner that seems to go on forever.
character: A long, ever-tightening Turn 1 and a 1.2 km back straight, one of the longest in F1. Front-left tyre wear is a constant theme.

corners.name: Turns 1 and 2
corners.note: A right-hander that keeps tightening for what feels like a minute.

corners.name: Turn 13
corners.note: A long right onto the back straight. Get the exit right and you can pass into Turn 14.

moments.title: Hamilton stuck in the pit lane gravel
moments.body: Leading the championship as a rookie, Lewis Hamilton stayed out on worn tyres and slid into the gravel at the pit lane entry. He lost the title by one point two weeks later.
